ACT XXIII OF 2021
SUPERIOR COLLEGE, LAHORE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the Superior College,
Lahore Act, 2004
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
26th July, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(59)/2021/2591, dated 26.7.2021.---The Superior College, Lahore (Amendment) Bill 2021, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 9, 2021, and assented to by
the Governor of the Punjab on July 23, 2021, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Superior College, Lahore Act 2004 (XVI of 2004) in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Superior College, Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment in the long title and the Preamble of Act XVI of 2004

by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 9, 2021, and assented to by
the Governor of the Punjab on July 23, 2021, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Superior College, Lahore Act 2004 (XVI of 2004) in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
in the long title and the Preamble of Act XVI of 2004.---In the Superior College, Lahore Act 2004 (XVI of
2004), for brevity cited as 'the Act':
(i) in
the long title, for the words "Superior College", the words
"Superior University" shall be substituted; and
(ii) in
the Preamble, for the words "Superior College", the words
"Superior University" shall be substituted.

Amendment in section 2 of Act XVI of 2004

Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Superior College, Lahore Act 2004 (XVI of 2004) in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
3. Amendment
in section 2 of Act XVI of 2004.---In
the Act, in section 2:
(i) for
clause (b), the following shall be substituted;
"(b)
"Chairman" means Chairman Board of Governors;";
(ii) for
clause (e), the following shall be substituted;
"(e)
"Patron" means Patron of the University;";
(iii) for
clause (f), the following shall be substituted;
"(f)
"Rector" means Rector of the University;"; and
(iv) in
clause (g), the full stop occurring at the end shall be replaced with the
semicolon and after clause (g), the following new clause (h) shall be inserted:
"(h)
"University" means the Superior University, Lahore, as constituted
under this Act".

Amendment in section 3 of Act XVI of 2004

the Governor of the Punjab on July 23, 2021, is hereby published as an Act of
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Superior College, Lahore Act 2004 (XVI of 2004) in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
4. Amendment
in section 3 of Act XVI of 2004.---In
the Act, for section 3, the following shall be substituted:
"3.
Establishment of the University.---(1) There shall be established a
University to be called the Superior University, Lahore, in the private sector
with its principal campus located at Lahore.
(2) The
University shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common
seal with power to acquire, hold and dispose of property and shall by the said
name sue and be sued."

5. Amendments
in section 4 of Act XVI of 2004.---In
the Act, in section 4:
(i) for
the marginal heading "Functions and powers of the Institute",
the marginal heading "Functions and Powers of the University"
shall be substituted;
(ii) in
clause (a), for sub-clause (i), the following shall be substituted:
"(i)
Faculties of Business and Management Sciences, Economics and Commerce, Computer
Science and Information Technology, law, Sciences, Engineering and Technology,
Medical Science, Allied Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Arts and Humanities,
Art and Design, Pharmacy, Agriculture and Veterinary Sciences; and"; and
(iii) for
clause (g), the following shall be substituted;
"(g)
to decide teaching methods and strategies including virtual, on-campus and,
online, distance learning, etc. in a such manner as prescribed by the Board to
ensure the most effective educational and training programs.".
